**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The Agreement contains no MFN/most-favoured-customer mechanic in either direction. I checked the planner's candidate sections (Section 11 Fees, Section 10 Maintenance and Support, Section 20 General Matters) and ran document-wide searches for "most favoured/favorable", "no less favourable", "other customers", "lowest", "terms offered", "price" and "any third party". The only fee obligation on Sparkling is a plain covenant to pay scheduled amounts (p0084), with maintenance provided at Fee Schedule rates (p0065) — nothing requiring us to extend Garman terms given to third parties or to match competing offers.

This sits at the rule's **preferred** position (no MFN obligation burdening the Customer), so nothing is flagged. Worth noting for the commercial team only: there is also no Vendor-granted MFN in our favour, which we could pursue as an upside ask if pricing benchmarking matters.
